faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer construction and civil works, plumbing and drainage, renovations, electrical services, paving and property maintenance. Contact us to discuss the work you need.

faqs.question: How do I request a quotation?
faqs.answer: Call or WhatsApp +27 67 245 9452, or email info@alexcivilengineering.co.za. Include your location, a description of the work and any useful photos or plans.

faqs.question: Can you assess my project on site?
faqs.answer: Contact the team to discuss your project and arrange a suitable site visit where required.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: Send us your project location so we can confirm availability and discuss travel requirements.
